edges: The Prime Minister volunteers his son Martin to find a special toy for Princess Petulant.
Martin talks with Princess Petulant and promises to return in four weeks with an amazing toy.
Martin encounters Bobolink, the Purple Enchanter, who knows everything.
Bobolink initially refuses to assist Martin but becomes eager to help after Martin's lack of flattery.
Martin becomes distracted and engages in conversation with a fish, which traps him in the country of conversation.
Princess Petulant waits for Martin to return with her toy but eventually becomes upset.
Princess Petulant finally makes it to Martin without speaking a single word.
The Toymaker is pleased to see Martin and Princess Petulant and wishes they stay and play with him forever.
Martin and Princess Petulant play with the best toys they have ever seen, satisfying the Princess’ desire for a new toy.
The Toymaker assists Martin and Princess Petulant in their journey home after they tell him they cannot stay.
Upon their return, Martin and Princess Petulant tell the entire story to a Royal Historian.
